judul: Module 5: Getting from A to B (can/can't, Articles, Transport)

hero.title: Bepergian dengan Bahasa Inggris
hero.text: can / can't untuk kemampuan dan izin, article a/an, the, dan zero (tanpa article), kosakata transportasi dan bandara, serta membeli tiket kereta.

cheatsheet.heading: Dua hal paling penting
cheatsheet.html: (1) can tidak pernah berubah dan selalu diikuti V1: She can take a bus. She can't take a taxi. (2) Article: a/an = salah satu/disebut pertama, the = yang sudah jelas/satu-satunya, tanpa article = nama kota/negara biasa, hari, makan, dan frasa tetap seperti by bus, go home.

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 1 • can / can't
cheatsheet.title: Pola Modal can
rows: She can take a bus at twenty past three.
She can't take a taxi because she's only got $25.
Can she take the subway to the airport?
Yes, S can. / No, S can't.
Can you travel by tram in New York? No, you can't.
Can you find a taxi easily in Hamburg? It depends.

modes.text: Positif: can lemah /kən/. Negatif: can't panjang & bertekanan /kɑ:nt/ (British) atau /kænt/ (American).

cheatsheet.title: Kendaraan & Kata Kerjanya
rows: drive a car, take a taxi

modes.label: drive vs ride
modes.title: ride = duduk di atas
modes.text: Kendaraan yang dinaiki dengan mengangkang (sepeda, motor, kuda) → ride. Mobil → drive.

modes.label: get on vs get in
modes.title: ➕ get on/off vs get in/out of
modes.text: Kendaraan besar yang bisa berdiri di dalamnya (bus, train, plane) → get on/off. Mobil, taksi → get in/out of.

Satu-satunya/sudah jelas: the city centre, the capital, on the right, in the morning, the USA/UK/UAE.
Nama orang, kota, negara biasa, hari, olahraga, frasa tetap (go to work, go home, at school, by bus).

ringkasan:
*RANGKUMAN P6 BAHASA INGGRIS: GETTING FROM A TO B*
1️⃣ can/can't + V1 (tanpa -s, tanpa to). Can she…? Yes, she can. / It depends.
2️⃣ a/an: disebut pertama, pekerjaan. the: satu-satunya/sudah jelas (the city centre, the USA, in the morning).
3️⃣ Tanpa article: nama, kota, negara biasa, hari, go to work, go home, by bus, on foot.
4️⃣ drive a car • ride a bicycle • take/catch a bus • get on/off a train • fly to.
5️⃣ Bandara: check in, boarding, in transit, delayed, last call, proceed to.
6️⃣ Tiket: Single or return? Which platform? What time does it arrive?

materi.label: Bagian 1
materi.title: Isi Module 5
materi.html:
Module 5 Getting from A to B membahas can dan can't; article a/an, the, dan zero article; kosakata dan bacaan tentang transportasi (Transport facts!); listening di bandara; survei transportasi; dan real life: membeli tiket.

Kosakata kendaraan: a motorbike, a bus, a train, a tram, a taxi, an aeroplane, a car, a ship, a scooter, a ferry, a bicycle, an underground / a subway train. Frasa: people waiting in a queue, passengers, a crowded train, travelling fast/slowly, bad traffic. Cara bepergian: by car, by bus, on foot.

materi.label: Bagian 2
materi.title: Transport Facts! (ringkasan)
materi.html:
Teks modul berisi fakta angka, misalnya: kebanyakan negara menyetir di kanan, tetapi sejumlah negara (termasuk Jepang, India, Australia, Inggris) di kiri (➕ Indonesia juga di kiri); di Tokyo kereta bawah tanah tidak pernah ditunggu lebih dari beberapa menit tetapi sangat penuh; kereta Maglev Shanghai menempuh 30 km ke Bandara Pudong hanya dalam beberapa menit; Moscow Metro punya 165 stasiun dengan jutaan penumpang setiap hari; di Italia jutaan orang naik skuter.

Fokus bahasanya: membaca angka besar (one million, one hundred million, five hundred thousand) dan kata kerja yang berpasangan (drive a car, ride a bicycle, wait for a train, get on/off a train, fly to Atlanta, go by underground, take a train or a bus, walk to work).

modes.label: Tanpa -s
modes.title: hundred/thousand/million
modes.text: Setelah angka, tidak jamak: two million people. Jamak hanya jika tanpa angka: millions of people.

materi.label: Bagian 3
materi.title: Language Focus 1: can dan can't
materi.html:
Karen ada di Metropolitan Museum of Art, Manhattan. Ia punya $25, sekarang jam ten past three, dan harus tiba di JFK Airport half past four. Ada empat cara: taksi ($35 + tip), subway + bus (90 menit, $2), jalan kaki + subway + AirTrain (±1 jam 32 menit, $7), atau subway ke Grand Central lalu New York Airport Express bus (±1 jam, $2 + $13, berangkat tiap 20 menit).

Kesimpulan grammar modul: She can take a bus at twenty past three. She can't take a taxi because she's only got $25. Can she take the subway to the airport? — can sama untuk semua subjek dan diikuti kata kerja dasar.

materi.heading: ➕ can untuk kemampuan diri
materi.html: Gunakan untuk CV/wawancara: I can speak English and Indonesian. I can use Microsoft Excel. I can't drive, but I can ride a motorbike.

materi.label: Bagian 4
materi.title: Language Focus 2: Articles a/an, the, dan zero
materi.html:
Teks tentang Salem Al-Romeithi: 23 tahun, an engineer, tinggal bersama keluarga di rumah besar di Dubai, kota besar di the United Arab Emirates. Ia bekerja di perusahaan internasional dari Saturday sampai Wednesday, dan di weekend ia selalu bermain golf.

  • a/an: menyebut sesuatu pertama kali atau salah satu dari banyak; pekerjaan.
  • the: sesuatu yang sudah jelas atau hanya satu (the capital city, the city centre, on the right); bagian hari (in the morning); negara gabungan (the UAE, the USA, the UK); at the weekend.
  • tanpa article: nama orang, kota, negara biasa, hari; frasa tetap go to work, go home, at school, by bus, by car, on foot.

materi.label: Bagian 5
materi.title: Real Life: Buying a Ticket
materi.html:
Florence di London ingin ke Paris. Urutan percakapan: A ticket to Paris, please … the six o'clock train. — Single or return? — Single. — That's £94.50. — Here you are. — Thank you. Sign there, please. — Thanks. Which platform is it? — Platform eighteen.

Informasi yang biasa ditanyakan: tujuan, single/return, jam kereta, peron, jam tiba. Kalimat tanya: How much is it? What time is the next train? Which platform is it? What time does it arrive?

items.en: A return ticket to Glasgow, please.
